unit: 5 Aids to trade that support commerce
topic: 5.4 Sources of finance and commercial performance
outcome: Know the calculation of revenue, gross profit, gross profit margin, profit for the year (net profit), working capital and mark-up percentage: Revenue (Sales or Turnover) = Selling price per unit × Number of units sold; Gross profit = Revenue – Cost of Sales (the cost of purchasing inventory); Gross profit margin (%) = Gross profit ÷ Revenue × 100; Net profit/net loss for the year = Gross profit – Expenses; Working capital = Current assets – Current liabilities; Mark-up percentage = (Average Selling Price – Unit Cost) ÷ Unit Cost.
